$comment: Overlay ports: libtorrent is the baseline port plus fix-i2p-stream-buffer-uaf.patch (I2P SAM use-after-free) and fix-i2p-outgoing-bind.patch (no interface bind for I2P peer sockets) and fix-i2p-accept-after-router-restart.patch (incoming I2P recovers after a router restart) and fix-i2p-reconnect-backoff.patch (SAM bridge retry backs off), docs/torrent/libtorrent-i2p-stream-uaf.md; rapidyenc (SIMD yEnc) and par2-turbo (PAR2 verify/repair) have no vcpkg port of their own. The CMake build can FetchContent both, but the hand-maintained src/eMuleQt.sln resolves everything from src/vcpkg_installed/, so without these the MSBuild build silently loses SIMD yEnc decoding and all PAR2 support. Having them here also stops the Windows CI job rebuilding them from source on every run.
